22 · Opening cargo doors and wide ramp

cues.text: All coordinates are in metres. The four-person cabin floor is 1.58 m above ground; a 1.80 m human figure provides a reference for checking the usable space.

The interior is 3.56 m wide. A clear aisle of at least 72 cm remains between the seats, with more than 2 m of headroom beside the sloping roof shoulders.
Two pilots sit in front and two passengers behind, all facing forward. The seat cushions are approximately 55 cm above the cabin floor; each seat has a separate headrest and safety harness.

Ceramic-colored hull panels receive a dark impact protection belt and orange identification stripes. The aft service covers align with the interior life-support equipment.
Two open-bell main engines are fitted below the floor. The side pods stop ahead of the crew entrance, keeping the door and ramp approach clear.
